authority_note: Compiled by hand from docs/OWNER_APPROVED_ROADMAP_2026-10-25.md (owner-approved, standing development authorization). The roadmap states what to achieve; slices are bounded, ordered steps toward it.

capabilities.capability: One submitted research question runs the complete local-compute / online-source Research Report workflow in the Web UI with progress, evidence, source links, citation provenance, uncertainty, a final report and useful errors, without a pre-ingested corpus or a mandatory Ollama.
completion_evidence: docs/OWNER_APPROVED_ROADMAP_2026-10-25.md Research Report user experience and Next slices

slices.objective: Audit /ask and the Research Report flow for mandatory local-corpus or Ollama dependencies, record each one with its file references, and pin each in a characterization test so the orchestration slice removes it deliberately. This slice changes docs and tests only and does not remove dependencies.
acceptance: docs/web_ask_report_dependency_audit.md lists every mandatory local-corpus or Ollama dependency with file references, or states there is none
a characterization test pins each recorded dependency as it exists today (for example a configured model being required), so removing it in the orchestration slice is an explicit test change
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.

slices.objective: Add one-request report orchestration to the Web UI with observable progress, source links, citation provenance, uncertainty and useful error states.
acceptance: a single submitted question drives discovery, retrieval, analysis and the final report
progress, evidence, source links, citations, uncertainty and errors are visible in the UI
no persistent bulk storage is required and temporary data is bounded and cleaned up
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.

slices.objective: Verify a real online-source report and its cleanup through product-native acceptance tests.
acceptance: an acceptance test runs a report from online sources and checks citations and uncertainty
temporary data retention is bounded and cleanup is asserted
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review must pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.
